description: This file defines the SugarSession class, which manages PHP sessions within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for starting, destroying, and accessing session data, and provides singleton access to the session instance.

classes.name: SugarSession
classes.description: A class that encapsulates PHP session management, providing methods for starting, destroying, and accessing session data, implementing singleton pattern.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session object; checks for existing session ID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a session if none exists and sets the session ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the SugarSession instance.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Clears session variables and destroys the session.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the session at object destruction.
